_doc: The allowlists a console panel may draw from, and the limits every panel lives inside. Read by company/tools/console-panel.js (validate, add, render) and by the console backend. A panel names a source by its id here; it can never name a command, a URL or a path outside these lists. This file is a shared policy: changing it is a 'tools' change through harness-change.js, owned by the tools function and reviewed by risk. console-panel.js never writes it.

file._doc: Read-only file sources. A panel gives a glob relative to the project root. It must start with one of the roots, end in one of the extensions, contain no '..', no absolute path, no backslash, no dot-segment and no 'secrets' segment, and match none of the deny globs. Symlinks are never followed.

tool._doc: Read-only company tool commands, run as `node company/tools/<argv[0]> <argv[1..]>` with no shell, a timeout and the panel's own data cap. Every entry must print JSON on stdout and change nothing.

handoffs-due.description: Open handoffs across all inboxes, sorted by deadline: [{due, raw, file, line, heading, overdue}]

owner-messages-new.description: Owner messages nobody has acknowledged yet: [{id, at, from, text, answersQuestion}]

owner-questions.description: Open owner questions with their recommendation and default

duties.description: Every duty check and what it says now (docs/DUTIES.md): [{id, route, owner, state ok|due|broken|stale|off, checkedAt, reason, history}]; the state is computed by the tool, never by the view

departments.description: The departments (docs/DEPARTMENTS.md): {departments: [{id, name, lead, leadName, members: [{id, name, isLead, escalatesTo}], defaultClass, briefChars}], unassigned, drift: {ok, mismatches, notes}, proposals}

routing.description: Model routing (docs/ROUTING.md), read only: {mode, tierCaps: {mode, allow}, classRules, trials: [{id, class, status, entryShare, scope, arms: [{label, items, wakes, shadowItems, shadowWakes}], reasons, progress: {minItemsPerArm, lowestArm, enough}}], log}; the owner changes it in Settings > Models > Routing

station._doc: GET-only station endpoints, called by the console backend with the station token. Offline render (console-panel.js render without --live) reports them as not resolved.

roster.description: Crew roster as the station sees it

limits._doc: The 'within reason' numbers. perPlacement counts installed panels (hidden ones included) per placement: today = the Today screen; side = per screen's side column; screen = company screens under the Company nav group.

page._doc: A page (company/console/pages/<id>/page.json) is a company screen made of units on a 12-column grid. It counts toward perPlacement.screen like a single-panel screen.

screens._doc: Console screens. sideAllowed = screens whose side column may hold company panels. protected = screens no panel may touch. builtinLabels = nav labels a company screen may not reuse.

actions._doc: The only doors a panel action may open. Each ends in an existing channel and asks the owner to confirm first. None writes company data directly, moves money or leaves the company.
actions.handoff: append a handoff block (HANDOFFS.md format, Status OPEN, from the owner via the console) to the inbox of the seat holding `to`
actions.ask-ceo: append an owner message to company/owner/inbound.jsonl; the CEO reads and acknowledges it (owner-inbox.js)
actions.owner-question-draft: prefill the owner's Comms composer with the text; nothing is sent until the owner presses send

styleTokens._doc: The CSS custom properties the console injects into every custom view. A custom view styles itself with var(--cap-*) from this list only.
